description: Single-edit mutations of verify_dimsum_and_melocoton_wrappers.py. Apply exactly one (first occurrence of 'search' replaced by 'replace'), run the mutated copy from a scratch directory with 'python3 -B', and expect a non-zero exit status with at least the listed checks failing. A mutant that still exits 0 means the probe has lost discriminating power.

mutations.name: gc_never_moves
mutations.replace: opts = [old[g]] if g in old else [fresh[g]]

mutations.name: sim_ignores_angelic_side
